title: Autonomous Intelligence Expansion
purpose: Expand the provider-independent Functional-AI frontier into model development, specialization, multi-agent/self-improvement/distributed vertical slices, and independent autonomous/research acceptance without erasing the remaining masterplan breadth.

rationale: Start P3 with the remaining model-development and scientific foundations required to improve the local AI itself.
Move next into specialized/domain behavior and trust surfaces before permitting broad autonomous acceptance claims.
Materialize VS-002 through VS-007 as executable vertical slices rather than architecture-only milestones.
Gate autonomous-worker, research-system and SOTA-candidate acceptance on independent evidence from the vertical suite.
Keep the other 234 inherited volumes explicit and queued; P3-T0 is expansion, not blanket completion.

workstreams.name: Model, research and multimodal foundation
workstreams.objective: Turn the remaining scientific/model-development/world-model/multimodal foundation into executable, provenance-bound capability without regressing the provider-independent Functional-AI frontier.

workstreams.name: Specialized and domain intelligence
workstreams.objective: Materialize bounded specialization, Jeeves domain custody, simulation intelligence, and education behavior on top of the local functional runtime.

workstreams.name: Explainability, accessibility, internationalization and compliance
workstreams.objective: Bind explanations, accessible interaction, locale behavior, and compliance controls to operation evidence instead of presentation-only claims.

workstreams.name: VS-002 through VS-007 executable validation suite
workstreams.objective: Materialize engineering, scientific-research, multi-agent, self-improvement, distributed-execution, and desktop-product vertical slices with independent evidence.

workstreams.name: Autonomous worker, research system and SOTA-candidate acceptance
workstreams.objective: Create strict acceptance envelopes for autonomous work, research, and SOTA-candidate claims; require negative, aging, recovery, and independent-verification evidence.

workstreams.name: Construction manual and technology radar authority
workstreams.objective: Make the construction manual and technology radar deterministic projections of machine/runtime evidence with no self-promoting completion authority.

invariants: P3 source scope equals the exact 257-volume queue left by the merged P2 Functional-AI frontier.
P3-T0 scheduled and queued partitions are disjoint and together cover all 257 source volumes.
Every scheduled volume has exactly one task owner.
Task-local acceptance may add constraints but may not narrow canonical masterplan contracts, risks, gaps, tests, evaluations, accountability, or signing requirements.
File existence, line count, or documentation never promotes masterplan maturity.
No implementation task may self-sign independent verification.
The P2 provider-independent Functional-AI closure remains a required predecessor and may not be weakened by P3.
